replay_source.scorer: FROZEN -- every score read from snapshot.observations; no oracle is constructed

method.no_transcription: BEFORE and AFTER both drive the production ProgramOptimizer.selection / PmoPopulationController.selection on an object restored by the production ProgramOptimizer.restore. Nothing is reimplemented in the harness.

predeclared_outcomes.claim: Parents actually drawn should track the archive's own heavy-atom distribution rather than sitting ~7 atoms below it.
predeclared_outcomes.pass_condition: AFTER median drawn is within 2 heavy atoms of the archive median, and the sub-10 drawn share falls substantially from its BEFORE value

predeclared_outcomes.claim: A badly-scoring singleton should lose mass when its score drops.
predeclared_outcomes.before_expectation: swinging a one-atom fragment from 0.01 to 0.99 changes its parent mass by exactly 0.0000
predeclared_outcomes.pass_condition: AFTER, the same swing moves the singleton's mass by a strictly positive amount, and the direction is monotone (higher score -> more mass)
predeclared_outcomes.control: a drug-like archive member swung over the same range must also move (it moved 0.0083 -> 0.1083 BEFORE); if the control stops moving the fix is broken, not working

predeclared_outcomes.claim: Plateau escape must drain rather than latch.
predeclared_outcomes.before_expectation: escape True for 8 consecutive rounds, never releasing
predeclared_outcomes.pass_condition: AFTER, no escape episode on the same measured best-score sequence exceeds its declared duration, and escape is False for at least one round inside the BEFORE 8-round latch window

predeclared_outcomes.claim: The measured-dead jump lane must not hold a fixed floor quota, but must keep a recoverable exploration floor.
predeclared_outcomes.pass_condition: AFTER, the jump lane's guaranteed floor quota is 0 while its achievable share is strictly positive when its measured yield is competitive

predeclared_outcomes.claim: Exploration weight sized for docking fragments credit into ~1-trial cells.
predeclared_outcomes.before_expectation: ~1.1 trials per cell; untried value 0.2500 outranks a 1-trial cell that delivered +0.05
predeclared_outcomes.pass_condition: AFTER, an untried cell no longer strictly outranks a 1-trial cell that delivered an improvement at the MEASURED reward scale (mean positive improvement u ~ 0.0077)

predeclared_outcomes.claim: Fewer than 10 molecules should not hold ~80% of parent mass by virtue of structural isolation.
predeclared_outcomes.pass_condition: reported either way; a rise in the count is only meaningful alongside P1 and P2

negative_result_policy: A fix that does not move its predeclared metric is reported as a clean negative and is not re-tuned until it does.
